answer: The wharf lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ivory is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the whisper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
